en: A black-and-white image shows a half-timbered building surrounded by dense trees, in a rural valley setting with hills in the background. The building has prominent gabled roofs, bay windows, and visible ivy on the walls. A sign on the building reads 'Hotel Kurhaus.' In the mid-ground, there's a long wooden aqueduct or trestle structure. The scene is tranquil, showcasing both architecture and the scenic landscape.
